items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Sie können gegen diesen Bescheid binnen zwei Wochen nach Zustellung Einspruch einlegen – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Musterland – Bußgeldstelle.
items.computation: The attached Postzustellungsurkunde (envelope scan, page 2) records the actual formal delivery date as 19.09.2026 (Saturday) — 'zugestellt am 19.09.2026' — so this documented date, not the deemed-delivery fiction, is the start of the objection period. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself (19.09.2026) is not counted, so the two-week period begins 20.09.2026. Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period in weeks ends with the day of the last week bearing the same name as the day the period began, i.e. two weeks after 19.09.2026 = 03.10.2026 (Saturday), which is also the Tag der Deutschen Einheit public holiday in NW. Under § 193 BGB / § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG, when the last day of a period falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, it moves to the next business day: Monday, 05.10.2026.

items.title: Pay the total fine (Geldbuße, fee and costs)
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens zwei Wochen nach Rechtskraft unter Angabe des Aktenzeichens auf das unten genannte Konto.
items.computation: The Bescheid becomes rechtskräftig (final) only if no Einspruch is filed within the objection period, i.e. at the end of 05.10.2026 (the objection deadline computed above, itself already shifted from the Saturday holiday of 03.10.2026). Counting the payment period from that trigger day: per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of Rechtskraft (05.10.2026) is not counted, so the two-week period starts 06.10.2026. Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB it ends two weeks later on the corresponding weekday: Monday, 19.10.2026, which is an ordinary business day (no shift needed).

warnings: The payment deadline of 19.10.2026 only applies if no Einspruch is filed by 05.10.2026; a timely objection prevents Rechtskraft and suspends the payment obligation pending the outcome.

The letter includes a scanned copy of the delivery envelope (Postzustellungsurkunde) showing a documented delivery date of 19.09.2026 — this actual delivery date was used instead of the statutory deemed-delivery presumption, since it is more precise; verify this date against your own envelope/mail record if available.
